headline: Uzbekistan Links Aviation Fuel Prices to Global Rates and Grants Tax Breaks
summary: Uzbekistan will link domestic aviation fuel prices to global market rates starting in 2027 and introduce tax incentives, including excise exemptions and zero VAT for local airlines.
why: Deregulation of fuel pricing and tax incentives alter operating cost structures for the domestic civil aviation sector.

impacts.name: Airlines Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Tax exemptions and aligned fuel pricing mechanisms affect operating margins for regional airlines.
